title: Pilgrim roads: there is more of the Way of St James in Germany than in Spain
excerpt: I measured every waymarked pilgrim route in OpenStreetMap without counting any stretch twice: 77,804 km. 41,674 km lead to Santiago, and Germany has 14,814 km of them against Spain's 9,922.
seo_description: A map of 77,804 km of waymarked pilgrim routes and 1,330 pilgrimage sites: the Camino web, the Via Francigena and the St Olav Ways.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Pilgrim roads' in orange and black on pale paper, beside a map of Europe covered in coloured route lines: an orange web of Camino routes across Spain, Germany and Poland, a blue Via Francigena down Italy, teal St Olav Ways in Norway and Sweden and purple Marian ways in Hungary, with dashed rings around Santiago de Compostela. Text: 77,804 km of waymarked pilgrim routes, 41,674 km of them signed for Santiago, and 1,330 pilgrimage sites.
